rationale: This inscription represents a judicial treaty (symbolon) between the Ionian cities of Miletus and Priene. It outlines the procedures for cross-border litigation, specifying that Milesians should be tried in Priene and Prienians in Miletus. It designates the specific magistrates (Strategoi in Priene and Epimeletai in Miletus) to handle these cases and mentions the religious context of the proceedings at the Sanctuary of Athena.
